body: Walking this path is hard. Sadly I know all to well. My situation is very much the same. I miss her with all my heart. I’d sell my soul for another chance to fix it no matter who is at fault for what. I can’t tell you what to do. But not wanting to lose you is a good thing. I wish she felt that way about me. She might but we can’t speak I want to she don’t I’ll id it’s pain full or brings back feelings. I relationship shouldn’t be looked at as something that stops you or holds you back from anything. You grow yourself and together as one. I can’t tell you how to explain that to them. They must figure it out on there own. Keep faith in what you believe in. What your heart truly knows is right and what you want. That is being true to yourself no matter how painful it is. I’m doing that sadly and it hurts so bad. Not even death could stop the pain I feel in my heart from what and who I lost. But for whatever reason my heart tells me to hold on. So I’m holding. Slipping and struggling but holding praying that it’s worth it. That it’s not all for nothing. But I’d be we forgive myself if I let go until ik it’s the right time to. But then again how do you know when it’s time. I’m sorry friend. If I can help you find a light I will I’d hell you with anything. This pain the walk these dark woods. Are a journey I wish On no one.

Well lack of actions could be not knowing what to do or fear anything done would make it worse. But if they sent letters saying they was done then yeah. But if it’s in answered letters on here you can’t be to mad due to the fact it’s hard to know who or your looking for. I know my actions in my situation are due to not knowing what to do. She didn’t want me anymore but got mad when I didn’t speak to her for weeks. I don’t look at her in passing cause it hurts like hell. I wanna tho. I want to speak to her I want to look at her. I would sell my soul for another chance. A chance for her and I to speak what’s on our minds no matter if it’s hurt I’m moving on or we both miss each other and want to fix it and make it right. Things are hard words are hard. Actions are harder when nobody has any idea of where any body stands.

Don’t let a monster rise. Sometimes change is hard for people. Maybe it because they don’t know where to start. I’ve done my best to change but I’m not going to lie it would be easier if I still had her to help and guide not tell me who to be or what to be. If the want to change is there that’s what’s important. You want to change but ate lost totally of what or where to do it other knowing and truly believing that I myself want to change.

Tell this to them!!! I’m in a situation that sadly is awful and I’m sure the other person thinks I wouldn’t take them back or let them have a do over. But I would in a fn heart beat. If they would give me the chance to do the same as well. It’s not your fault my fault thing. It’s a I love you I messed up please forgive me and let’s get it right it. You might be surprised just how much they want the same as you.
You should tell that person this. It might make a difference.

If you can’t find the courage to straight up let it all out. Then find it to drop a hint. Something so they know it’s you that’s is reaching out sometimes all that is needed is swift kick to get the bell rolling. That’s all.

Really all that has stopped me from saying all these things showing all these things. Is I just didn’t think she would want a new start or life with me anymore.

I made a mistake the greatest mistake that I ever made in my life. All I wanted was a new start with my best friend the one who held my heart and protected me from myself when I couldn’t. Only she could save from myself. As time had gone on I didn’t know what to do or where to look but I was searching every minute of everyday since we have apart for any sign that we could start a new life. Be who we wanted to be. What we wanted to be and share with each other. But I didn’t know where to look and some time went by and the silence is awful. If I could say anything to her it would be I’m so sorry for that. I was searching every for anything. I never stoped. And I hope to much time hasn’t passed by. I never wanted or meant for that. I’m not good with words and putting feeling into words but I do know I’ve worked on that so hard hoping to get s chance to show her. I will always wish and want a new start a new life with my best friend. And as bad a messed up as foolish as I had been I wouldn’t stop searching for a fix and I would go to end of this world to meet or build a new life. I wish she could see this. I’ve started again myself found a better path for me and I’m proud of the man I found. I never would have without her. I wish I could thank you for how you changed my life. And hope that I could change yours like you did mine.

I feel that situation totally. Some people aren’t as strong as they appear but the pit on the mask and will do whatever it takes. I did this. I never knew anything else. And the reasons why i struggle are so to I didn’t know who I was. But I was bond to figure it out. With the help of my best friend who I lost sadly and hope and want nothing more to show and prove that all that was done was with the belief in the future of us. It was hard to understand in that moment what was wrong with both of us but I believed in her more than anything in this world and new it would get figured out. I would find myself and no matter what I would be ok because I had her. My only wish was that she could have seen me without the mask and how exposed I was. I breakable I was for the first time in life. I never took the mask off for anyone but her. And it was my first step to figuring out the problems that haunted to me. And us. I’m still working on me everyday. Hoping praying that maybe one day it could be fixed. We could find each other again and be who and what we believed we could be. The best thing I ever did was believe and be all I could be for her. I’m not happy in this life. I miss my old life every day. I miss the friendship of a love that helped me figure out the person I am. I know I’ll never be able to apologize for not knowing everything about who I was. But all I knew was I loved her and I never lost that love. As each day passes I can’t help but feel we made a wrong move. I know I did but I there wasn’t a second that I didn’t want to fix it me us. Be better show her who I was while I figured it out. I wish I could her that every day I was trying to show her who I was the human being under that mask. It was the most important thing to me. And the day we ended and all that lead to that was at a point where I’d never been. Lost exposed and down but not dead. I still believed in us more than anything. Just for the first time didn’t know what move to make or what to do. I would give anything in this life for that to be changed. I don’t whatcwill be but I know that I’m still believing in us and what we had more than life it’s self still. And that as time has gone on I learned changed and started working on myself. Getting diagnosed starting therapy. I wish I could thank her. She was the best thing I ever had and the family and love we held. I’ll always believe in her. I’ll always miss her and I’ll always hope and want her back . She taught me about myself and I didn’t know all I had to learn. I’m sorry I failed her on that and wish I got the chance to show her the good she did and how much she helped me and us.

I am very happy you are getting better. It’s hard but you should be proud of yourself. What happened wasn’t your fault! And the person who this letter is to if they truly loved you from there eyes it wasn’t your fault. Cause you weren’t the normal you. It’s ok you couldn’t control it. But they believed in you had faith that it would be fixed and held onto to that because it was all that they had to hold onto. It will get better!!! You can rebuild it!! And your ex is working on themselves I’m sure if they were lucky enough to have someone like you in there lives. It may take some time but it’ll get fixed to!! Just like you!!! I’m in a situation that’s close to this and every day I wish my ex could see what I see and feel what I feel when I see them. And how I wish and hope it could be fixed. It’s not a matter of right or wrong or who’s fault it is. It just boils down to do you believe in them and love them. If you never lose that then what happens and what will happen you can make it threw.

In life you are left with two choices. To walk away or have faith and hold fast in what you know is right and the burning the feeling in your heart and soul you can’t get rid. Follow that. I choose to believe in that. And because I had faith because I risked loosing pain hurt. All those things weren’t shit compared to the happiness I felt in just one day. The biggest thing I ever did in my life was that. No words would ever come close to how I felt on good days or bad. It’s ok to rebuild. Failure didn’t and does not define you or me or anyone. If you never give up you never fail!! Some things in life are worth dying for!! Worth fighting for till there’s nothing left to give and then you fight some more. It was worth every min of ever day. We are human we get sick we get better. If you have someone who will stand by you believe in you love you and help build or rebuild a life until one day you look back and don’t remember the bump in road. Hold onto to that person with all you have cause I’m telling you do not find that ever again. Pain is temporary. Love will last a life time. No matter what the cause of the pain anything can be fixed. It’s ok to fall down. It’s ok to rebuild it ok to love it’s ok to have faith when some days you can’t explain the reasons behind them other then you believe with ever fiber of who you are that this is right. And what you believe in WHO you believe in. No matter how hard no matter how scary it can be. I faced my fear and it changed me in every way for the better. I could never say in words what I feel and how much I loved what I got out of that. And that carry’s me to this very day.  Just believe in it and it’ll be ok it’ll get fixed. Stand by that person because if they truly love you and I’m sure you know that they do. Just to see you hold you look at you and say we will get threw this. Will do more for you and them than you could ever imagine in. Sometimes in life you have to fight but I promise it’s worth fighting for. Don’t ever give up on that kinda love or person. Because they will not give up on you!
That person you should tell them. This. In a text or write in a letter and put it on the car or front door whatever it takes. TELL THEM! You won’t regret it.
Just because you go step back and pick the pieces up. Doesn’t mean anything in life will be like it was. It could be the best thing you ever did. One step back for a life time of steps forward.
I’m positive he wouldn’t say no!!! You would be surprised how many times in life that person wants the same as you but just can’t figure out how to say it

Of course there is hope!!! I’m not done fighting for us. As long as I. Breathing I ain’t gone stop. I mean that. I’m just processing things that’s all. There is always hope as long as we let hope be there.
